faq.q: Why use Grade 1 CP-Ti (Pt-coated) for titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Grade 1 CP-Ti offers the highest ductility and formability of all titanium grades, ideal for deep-drawn components, gaskets, and cryogenic applications requiring excellent low-temperature toughness.

faq.q: How is a titanium pem bipolar plate manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium pem bipolar plate is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion; CNC machining; TIG welding (ERTi-2 filler). BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 1 CP-Ti (Pt-coated) for titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Laser welding (higher capital cost, limited wall thickness capability).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Titanium PEM Bipolar Plate components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for custom titanium pem bipolar plate?
faq.a: Standard lead time is 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders can be accommodated. Contact our sales team for specific delivery schedules.
